title: 3D Acceleration for Mixture-of-Experts and Multi-Head Attention Spiking Transformers with Dynamic Head Pruning
problem: Spiking Neural Networks offer energy-efficient, brain-inspired computing, but lack hardware support for highly parallel distributed processing required by mixture-of-experts models. Conventional 2D CMOS integration cannot efficiently support MoE-based spiking transformers.
motivation: Energy-efficient AI demands brain-inspired approaches like SNNs combined with model parallelism from MoE; 3D integration enables efficient spatial distribution of expert processing.
method: Introduces first 3D hardware architecture for MoE and multi-head attention spiking transformers. Leverages 3D integration with memory-on-logic and logic-on-logic stacking for expert distribution. Implements dynamic head pruning in multi-head attention to reduce computation. Optimizes for energy efficiency and latency through stackable circuitry exploiting 3D interconnect benefits.
key_novelty: First 3D hardware architecture and design methodology for spiking transformer networks with MoE and dynamic attention pruning, demonstrating significant energy and latency improvements.
contributions: 3D hardware architecture supporting spatially distributed MoE processing
Memory-on-logic and logic-on-logic stacking for efficient MoE layout
Dynamic head pruning for multi-head attention energy reduction
Significant energy efficiency and latency improvements over 2D CMOS
limitations: Specific performance metrics not provided in abstract; comparison with other 3D accelerator designs not detailed; scalability to very large MoE models unclear.
